decision: Extend the Clarte frame generically: Clarte-only destinations passed by App as clarteScreens, an entry option viewNavigation 'screen', and tab renderers that receive the entry's offered views and the frame's link handler
why: The console needs a home and a Language and region destination that the current interface must never show, and draws its own grouped list of sections beside the chosen one; the frame keeps selection, mounting, focus and the protected-write hold
evidence: Issue #1546 criterion 1; apps/web/src/clarte/ClarteFrame.test.tsx 'Clarte-only screens and screens that draw their own views'; apps/web/src/clarte/README.md

decision: The Settings console's sections come from one registry, settings/settings-registry.ts, whose rows pick group, icon and whether the Clarte or the current screen shows; clarte-entries.ts takes the Settings tabs from it
why: #1547 adds configuration sections by changing one row, and not-yet-migrated sections stay reachable inside the console

decision: Move the commands and reads of Company access administration, membership suspension, session revocations, invitations and Company registration from their current components into hooks both interfaces use, without changing the current markup
why: A Clarte screen must reuse the existing transports, retries and recovery rules; duplicating them would let the two interfaces drift
evidence: Existing apps/web/src/access and apps/web/src/company test files unchanged and passing; apps/web/src/App.clarte-settings.test.tsx
